notes:
Fullobby 0.4.3

Auto-seed now wakes for each server's own seed window, not only for the
network's opening hour. Before, if your network opened at 06:00 and a
server's window opened at 07:30, the app woke at 06:00, found nothing to
seed yet, said "All servers are seeded", and slept through 07:30. It now
wakes for 07:30 too, and when it comes up early it says "Nothing to seed
yet — the next server window opens at HH:MM" and goes back to sleep.

After updating, glance at Settings → Auto-Seed: it should list a wake time
for every server window in your networks, not just one.

Answering a ready check confirms the server; it does not start anyone's
game. Seeding starts from these wakes or the Seed button.

Windows 10 support is back. Windows 10 version 2004 (build 19041) or newer
installs and runs again. The Manage tab needs Microsoft's WebView2 runtime,
which Windows 11 ships and Windows 10 doesn't; if that tab shows an
install-the-runtime message instead of the panel, that's expected.
